description.value: Whole Foods Market is a large natural and organic supermarket chain location in Victoria, BC, stocking a wide range of organic produce, sustainable seafood, and specialty grocery items. The store includes several in-house eateries — a pizza counter, a Mexican burrito bar (Market Cocina), and a sushi counter (Kikka Sushi) — making it a convenient stop for a full meal as well as resupply. Amazon Prime members receive exclusive in-store discounts, which may be useful for longer touring cyclists looking to stock up.
